data.action: 看着镜中剪短的头发，膝上的手指慢慢松开。
data.description: （辞职篇）美发沙龙，她看着镜中长发被一缕缕剪短落地，手指在膝上微微收紧又松开；镜中表情从紧绷到如释重负，是角色弧线最重的一幕。
data.promptProse: Ai Hayasaka watches the salon mirror as the last longer blonde strands fall, her hands tightening briefly on her knees before relaxing. A neat short bob now frames her relieved expression above a light-blue jacket and cream top. The medium view includes the mirror and cut hair near the chair base. Soft salon lighting illuminates her reflected cheek and fresh hair edges, with muted shadows beneath the chair and along the workstation.
data.title: 早坂爱 · 美发沙龙的决断
